text:
I am building a tandem, reverse-trike halftrack, using the front end of an ATV and the back end of a snowmobile.

Replacing the skis on a snowmobile with wheels is not a novel idea, but I wanted something which rides more like a motorcycle, with extra length for a passenger and a cargo basket.

It should end up looking like it came out of a Mad Max movie; I plan to cruise around at festivals with it, running an ad-hoc taxi service, as a way of meeting people and striking up conversations.
